sources.entry: WandelBar - Customizes the menu bar background with blur, tint, shadows, textures, presets, and per-Space settings. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/alexiosus/WandelBar) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: WandelBar is a native macOS menu bar utility that renders a customizable background (blur, tint, shadow, texture, presets) behind the menu bar by generating a modified wallpaper.
summary.what_it_does: It finds the wallpaper assigned to each active display and Space, renders a screen-sized copy with a Core Image treatment across the top strip, and sets that copy as the desktop wallpaper without editing the source image. Users can adjust blur radius, band height, edge fade, shadow strength and length, solid or gradient tint, opacity, saturation, and add PNG, JPEG, or HEIC textures with blend and position controls. It ships 26 built-in presets in four collections, supports favorites, undo, and personal presets, and can export or import `.wandelbar-presets` packages. Settings can apply to a default design or to the current desktop Space, and the original wallpaper is restored when the effect is turned off.
use_cases: restore menu bar contrast on a busy wallpaper
blur or tint the menu bar background on macOS Tahoe
apply retro or glass-style menu bar looks
set a different menu bar look per desktop Space
share or import custom menu bar presets
keep menu bar text readable on bright wallpapers
notable: Renders a modified copy of the wallpaper rather than overlaying a window, so the bar background is part of the desktop
Per-Space overrides for the current desktop Space
26 built-in presets plus a community gallery of verified preset packages
Shareable .wandelbar-presets packages and GitHub Discussions sharing flow
Signed with Developer ID and notarized; Homebrew cask available
caveats: Designed mainly for macOS Tahoe; on earlier releases (Sonoma and later) the system menu bar background cannot be disabled, so little reason to use it there
Relies on undocumented SkyLight APIs that may break in macOS updates; full-screen Spaces are untouched
Video and animated wallpapers are not supported and are left unchanged; current prebuilt releases are Apple silicon only
